title: Llama-3.2-1B & Qwen2.5-0.5B

about.name: Llama-3.2-1B
about.quote: The Llama 3.2 collection of multilingual large language models (LLMs) is a collection of pretrained and instruction-tuned generative models in 1B and 3B sizes (text in/text out).
about.label: Meta model card

about.name: Qwen2.5-0.5B
about.quote: Qwen2.5 is the latest series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2.5, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters.
about.label: Qwen model card

here: Here: the integers 0–99, each averaged over six sentences like “I counted 42 sheep.”, as Llama-3.2-1B layer-8 states for its single number token (A) and Qwen2.5-0.5B layer-12 states averaged over the number’s digit tokens (B).
